method: COMPILED FROM 2 SOURCES. S1: PARAPHRASED AND HASH-ANCHORED from Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) CKD-MBD Update Work Group, Kidney International Supplements 'KDIGO 2017 Clinical Practice Guideline Update for the Diagnosis, Evaluation, Prevention, and Treatment of Chronic Kidney Disease–Mineral and Bone Disorder (CKD-MBD)' (2017), 17 claims; LICENCE: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (read at PMC JATS XML <license> element for PMC6340919 (NCBI efetch; Europe PMC returned 503)). S2: PARAPHRASED AND HASH-ANCHORED from Kidney Health Australia (RACGP Accepted Clinical Resource; endorsed by ANZSN, APNA and the Renal Society of Australasia) 'Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) Management in Primary Care, 5th edition' (2024 (PDF dated July 2024)), 6 claims; LICENCE: © Kidney Health Australia ('no part may be reproduced without written permission') (read at the handbook's imprint page). Verify each source separately: verify.py --source <file> --only-source S<n>. Source text: NCBI efetch JATS XML (Europe PMC fullTextXML returned HTTP 503 on 2026-09-23). The recommendation statements appear both in the summary and in each chapter; spans take the first occurrence. Edition 2.0 adds S2, the Kidney Health Australia CKD handbook (5th edition, 2024), for the Australian primary-care position on mineral and bone disorder; its PDF was converted with pdftotext. No current KHA-CARI CKD-MBD guideline exists (the CARI bone guideline of 2006 is closed and superseded). All S1 claims and anchors are unchanged.

claims.claim: **Start checking calcium, phosphate, PTH and alkaline phosphatase from CKD G3a in adults (1C),** and from G2 in children (2D). How often depends on how abnormal the results are and how fast CKD is progressing.
claims.locator: Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) CKD-MBD Update Work Group, Kidney International Supplements, 'KDIGO 2017 Clinical Practice Guideline Update for the Diagnosis, Evaluation, Prevention, and Treatment of Chronic Kidney Disease–Mineral and Bone Disorder (CKD-MBD)', 2017, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6340919/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Consider measuring 25(OH) vitamin D,** and treat deficiency the same way as in the general population. (2C)
claims.locator: Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) CKD-MBD Update Work Group, Kidney International Supplements, 'KDIGO 2017 Clinical Practice Guideline Update for the Diagnosis, Evaluation, Prevention, and Treatment of Chronic Kidney Disease–Mineral and Bone Disorder (CKD-MBD)', 2017, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6340919/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Act on trends, not one result,** and look at calcium and phosphate separately rather than as a calcium-phosphate product. (1C, 2D)
claims.locator: Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) CKD-MBD Update Work Group, Kidney International Supplements, 'KDIGO 2017 Clinical Practice Guideline Update for the Diagnosis, Evaluation, Prevention, and Treatment of Chronic Kidney Disease–Mineral and Bone Disorder (CKD-MBD)', 2017, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6340919/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **PTH or bone-specific alkaline phosphatase can indicate bone turnover** when markedly high or low (2B). Test bone density if the result would change treatment (2B).
claims.locator: Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) CKD-MBD Update Work Group, Kidney International Supplements, 'KDIGO 2017 Clinical Practice Guideline Update for the Diagnosis, Evaluation, Prevention, and Treatment of Chronic Kidney Disease–Mineral and Bone Disorder (CKD-MBD)', 2017, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6340919/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: 🇦🇺 **Australian primary care (S2):** calcium, phosphate, PTH and vitamin D metabolism usually start to change once GFR is 60 or below, and the changes are linked to fracture and cardiovascular death, possibly through vascular calcification. Managing CKD-MBD is complex and usually runs through a nephrologist.
claims.locator: Kidney Health Australia (RACGP Accepted Clinical Resource; endorsed by ANZSN, APNA and the Renal Society of Australasia), 'Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) Management in Primary Care, 5th edition', 2024 (PDF dated July 2024), https://kidney.org.au/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/KHA-CKD-Handbook-5th-Ed-July2024.pdf, retrieved 2026-09-24

claims.claim: 🇦🇺 **When a GP tests (S2):** CKD-MBD usually does not need testing or treatment in stages 1–3. In the action plans for eGFR 30–59 with microalbuminuria (or 30–44 without) and for eGFR below 30, consider calcium and phosphate, and PTH every 6–12 months once eGFR is below 45.
claims.locator: Kidney Health Australia (RACGP Accepted Clinical Resource; endorsed by ANZSN, APNA and the Renal Society of Australasia), 'Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) Management in Primary Care, 5th edition', 2024 (PDF dated July 2024), https://kidney.org.au/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/KHA-CKD-Handbook-5th-Ed-July2024.pdf, retrieved 2026-09-24

claims.claim: 🇦🇺 **Bone density (S2):** in stages 3–5 with CKD-MBD or osteoporosis risk factors, BMD testing is suggested when the result would change treatment; low DXA BMD predicts fracture, and no one anti-resorptive is favoured.
claims.locator: Kidney Health Australia (RACGP Accepted Clinical Resource; endorsed by ANZSN, APNA and the Renal Society of Australasia), 'Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) Management in Primary Care, 5th edition', 2024 (PDF dated July 2024), https://kidney.org.au/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/KHA-CKD-Handbook-5th-Ed-July2024.pdf, retrieved 2026-09-24

claims.claim: **Base treatment on serial phosphate, calcium and PTH taken together.** Bring high phosphate down toward normal, and avoid hypercalcaemia in adults (keep calcium in the age-appropriate range in children). (2C)
claims.locator: Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) CKD-MBD Update Work Group, Kidney International Supplements, 'KDIGO 2017 Clinical Practice Guideline Update for the Diagnosis, Evaluation, Prevention, and Treatment of Chronic Kidney Disease–Mineral and Bone Disorder (CKD-MBD)', 2017, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6340919/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Start phosphate-lowering only for phosphate that is rising or stays high.** In adults, limit calcium-based binders (2B); avoid long-term aluminium binders (1C).
claims.locator: Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) CKD-MBD Update Work Group, Kidney International Supplements, 'KDIGO 2017 Clinical Practice Guideline Update for the Diagnosis, Evaluation, Prevention, and Treatment of Chronic Kidney Disease–Mineral and Bone Disorder (CKD-MBD)', 2017, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6340919/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Limit dietary phosphate,** taking its source (animal, plant, additives) into account (2D). On dialysis, increase dialytic phosphate removal for persistent hyperphosphataemia (2C), and use a dialysate calcium of 1.25–1.50 mmol/L (2C).
claims.locator: Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) CKD-MBD Update Work Group, Kidney International Supplements, 'KDIGO 2017 Clinical Practice Guideline Update for the Diagnosis, Evaluation, Prevention, and Treatment of Chronic Kidney Disease–Mineral and Bone Disorder (CKD-MBD)', 2017, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6340919/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: 🇦🇺 **S2:** bring phosphate toward the normal range (a kidney dietitian can help cut dietary phosphate) and avoid hypercalcaemia; do not overload with calcium supplements, because CKD brings vascular calcification.
claims.locator: Kidney Health Australia (RACGP Accepted Clinical Resource; endorsed by ANZSN, APNA and the Renal Society of Australasia), 'Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) Management in Primary Care, 5th edition', 2024 (PDF dated July 2024), https://kidney.org.au/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/KHA-CKD-Handbook-5th-Ed-July2024.pdf, retrieved 2026-09-24

claims.claim: **The ideal PTH before dialysis is unknown.** If intact PTH keeps rising or stays above the assay's upper limit, look for correctable causes such as raised serum phosphate, low calcium, a diet high in phosphate, or low vitamin D. (2C)
claims.locator: Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) CKD-MBD Update Work Group, Kidney International Supplements, 'KDIGO 2017 Clinical Practice Guideline Update for the Diagnosis, Evaluation, Prevention, and Treatment of Chronic Kidney Disease–Mineral and Bone Disorder (CKD-MBD)', 2017, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6340919/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **A modest PTH rise may be an appropriate adaptation** as kidney function falls, so do not start treatment on a single high value.
claims.locator: Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) CKD-MBD Update Work Group, Kidney International Supplements, 'KDIGO 2017 Clinical Practice Guideline Update for the Diagnosis, Evaluation, Prevention, and Treatment of Chronic Kidney Disease–Mineral and Bone Disorder (CKD-MBD)', 2017, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6340919/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Do not routinely give calcitriol or vitamin D analogues to adults before dialysis (2C).** Reserve them for severe hyperparathyroidism that keeps worsening in stage G4–G5. In children they may be used to keep calcium in the normal range.
claims.locator: Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) CKD-MBD Update Work Group, Kidney International Supplements, 'KDIGO 2017 Clinical Practice Guideline Update for the Diagnosis, Evaluation, Prevention, and Treatment of Chronic Kidney Disease–Mineral and Bone Disorder (CKD-MBD)', 2017, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6340919/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Why:** the PRIMO and OPERA trials of paricalcitol showed no heart benefit but more hypercalcaemia. If calcitriol or an analogue is started, begin with a low dose, titrate to PTH, and avoid hypercalcaemia.
claims.locator: Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) CKD-MBD Update Work Group, Kidney International Supplements, 'KDIGO 2017 Clinical Practice Guideline Update for the Diagnosis, Evaluation, Prevention, and Treatment of Chronic Kidney Disease–Mineral and Bone Disorder (CKD-MBD)', 2017, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6340919/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: 🇦🇺 **Vitamin D (S2):** in early CKD, vitamin D can be checked and topped up if low; in more advanced CKD with hypocalcaemia, calcitriol is preferred because the kidney can no longer hydroxylate 25-hydroxyvitamin D. S2 also says the optimal PTH in CKD is not known.
claims.locator: Kidney Health Australia (RACGP Accepted Clinical Resource; endorsed by ANZSN, APNA and the Renal Society of Australasia), 'Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) Management in Primary Care, 5th edition', 2024 (PDF dated July 2024), https://kidney.org.au/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/KHA-CKD-Handbook-5th-Ed-July2024.pdf, retrieved 2026-09-24

claims.claim: ⚠️🇦🇺 **Denosumab and other CKD-MBD treatments in stages 3–5: talk to a nephrologist before starting** (S2). Serial calcium, phosphate and PTH guide treatment, and the risk of hypocalcaemia after denosumab climbs as CKD advances, so watch calcium closely.
claims.locator: Kidney Health Australia (RACGP Accepted Clinical Resource; endorsed by ANZSN, APNA and the Renal Society of Australasia), 'Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) Management in Primary Care, 5th edition', 2024 (PDF dated July 2024), https://kidney.org.au/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/KHA-CKD-Handbook-5th-Ed-July2024.pdf, retrieved 2026-09-24

claims.claim: **Target:** keep intact PTH at roughly 2 to 9 times the assay's upper normal limit (2C). A marked change in either direction within that range should prompt starting or adjusting treatment.
claims.locator: Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) CKD-MBD Update Work Group, Kidney International Supplements, 'KDIGO 2017 Clinical Practice Guideline Update for the Diagnosis, Evaluation, Prevention, and Treatment of Chronic Kidney Disease–Mineral and Bone Disorder (CKD-MBD)', 2017, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6340919/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **To lower PTH on dialysis, use a calcimimetic (e.g. cinacalcet), calcitriol or a vitamin D analogue, or a calcimimetic plus calcitriol/analogue.** (2B) KDIGO lists them alphabetically, not in order of preference.
claims.locator: Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) CKD-MBD Update Work Group, Kidney International Supplements, 'KDIGO 2017 Clinical Practice Guideline Update for the Diagnosis, Evaluation, Prevention, and Treatment of Chronic Kidney Disease–Mineral and Bone Disorder (CKD-MBD)', 2017, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6340919/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Cinacalcet evidence (EVOLVE):** the trial missed its primary endpoint of death or major vascular events, though secondary analyses suggested benefit, especially in older patients. Its higher cost weighed against making it first-line.
claims.locator: Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) CKD-MBD Update Work Group, Kidney International Supplements, 'KDIGO 2017 Clinical Practice Guideline Update for the Diagnosis, Evaluation, Prevention, and Treatment of Chronic Kidney Disease–Mineral and Bone Disorder (CKD-MBD)', 2017, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6340919/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Choose the agent by the current calcium and phosphate and other treatments;** dialysate calcium also affects PTH.
claims.locator: Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) CKD-MBD Update Work Group, Kidney International Supplements, 'KDIGO 2017 Clinical Practice Guideline Update for the Diagnosis, Evaluation, Prevention, and Treatment of Chronic Kidney Disease–Mineral and Bone Disorder (CKD-MBD)', 2017, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6340919/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Children:** evidence for cinacalcet is limited to small series; use PTH-lowering drugs cautiously to avoid hypocalcaemia in a growing skeleton.
claims.locator: Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) CKD-MBD Update Work Group, Kidney International Supplements, 'KDIGO 2017 Clinical Practice Guideline Update for the Diagnosis, Evaluation, Prevention, and Treatment of Chronic Kidney Disease–Mineral and Bone Disorder (CKD-MBD)', 2017, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6340919/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Refer for parathyroidectomy** when severe hyperparathyroidism does not respond to medical treatment, at any stage from G3a to G5D. (2B)
claims.locator: Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) CKD-MBD Update Work Group, Kidney International Supplements, 'KDIGO 2017 Clinical Practice Guideline Update for the Diagnosis, Evaluation, Prevention, and Treatment of Chronic Kidney Disease–Mineral and Bone Disorder (CKD-MBD)', 2017, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6340919/, retrieved 2026-09-23
